title: Shipped seed intensity patterns
description: A top-level array of intensity pattern content records. Patterns ship as data, not code, so the coach can add, edit and delete them without the app being rebuilt. Content shape only: no record identity scheme, no revision, no device tag, no tombstone, no timestamps, no encryption markers. See SCHEMA.md sections 2.1 and 6.

id.description: Content key, not a record identity. Stable forever.

name.description: The button label. Where it contains intensity words they must appear in the same order as sequence (rule R11).

sequence.description: The curve itself: the ordered intensity points.

mappingRule.description: How a sequence of k points maps across a routine of n exercises. See SCHEMA.md 6.1 for the formula of each.

provenance.description: Where the record came from and whether the coach has edited it. Always shipped-untouched in a seed file. See SCHEMA.md 4.6.
